title: SkillCarryOverOffer

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

from.description: Where the skill folder was found: in the adopted directory's skills/, or in the machine's ~/.agents/skills.

url.description: The working tree's remote, as git expands it, stripped of any credential.

folder.description: The skill folder's path in the repository, from its root; . when the folder is the repository's root.

anyOf.description: A branch a skill source follows, as git takes a branch name: 1 to 255 characters with no white space, control character or any of ~ ^ : ? * [ \, no .. or @{, no empty segment, none beginning with . or ending with .lock, no trailing / or ., not @, and not beginning with -.

branch.description: The branch; null for the remote's default branch, the one its HEAD names.

oneOf.description: A branch the source syncs from, at start, every six hours and on Pull now.

commit.description: A git commit's full object name: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

oneOf.description: A commit the source is pinned to: it never syncs until it is unpinned.

follow.description: The branch the working tree is on (its upstream's on the remote, else the local one), or a pin at its commit when HEAD is detached.

description: A skill folder inside a git working tree with a remote, offered as a skill source instead of copied: the URL, folder and follow skills.sources.add takes.
